content.title: Santa Clara vs Kentucky Live Stream: How to Watch Men's NCAA Tournament
content.text: Santa Clara will face off against Kentucky in the first round of the NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament on Friday afternoon. The No. 10-seeded Santa Clara Broncos from the West Coast Conference will battle in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament against the No. 7-seeded Kentucky Wildcats from the Southeastern Conference on Friday afternoon in St. Louis, Missouri, at the Enterprise Center. The Wildcats finished the season with a 21-13 overall record, including a 10-8 record inside the Southeastern Conference. Heading into the SEC Tournament, they faced off against LSU in the first round and squeaked by that game by five points before facing Missouri in the second round. They won that game, 78-72. In the quarterfinals, Kentucky met up with No. 4-ranked Florida, a one-seed in the tournament, and lost by eight points. Still getting an at-large bid because of dynamic wins in the season, Kentucky has relied offensively on senior guard Otega Oweh. The 6-foot-4 star from New Jersey averaged 18.2 points, 4.6 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game this season. He was complemented by ex-Gator Denzel Aberdeen, who chipped in 13.2 points, 2.6 rebounds, and 3.6 assists per game, while shooting 43% from the floor. The Broncos won an at-large bid as well, finishing 15-3 in the conference and 26-8 overall. They opened up the conference tournament with an eight-point win over Pacific in the quarterfinal before squeaking past No. 21-ranked Saint Mary’s in the semifinals by five points. Matching up with No. 12-ranked Gonzaga, the conference favorite, in the championship game, the team came up just short despite Christian Hammond dropping a game-high 24 points. Hammond and Elijah Mahi have led Santa Clara all season and will power this team forward in the NCAA Tournament. Hammond, a 6-foot-4 guard, led the team with 15.8 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 2.4 assists per game.
